ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the main body with high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips; macro-level ratio estimated at 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central region spanning from peduncle to notch. High-intensity pixels are clustered at the lateral distal tips, specifically exhibiting a vertical striated pattern on the right lobe tip and a mottled cluster on the left lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant, extending roughly 12% into the fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated boundary. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits two distinct deep pixel voids (notches) at the upper margin. Right lobe shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trajectory follows a strong concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the distal-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible constellation of approximately 3-4 circular high-intensity pixel clusters located in the central medial region near the notch apex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of fine, multi-directional high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) mapped across both lobes, with highest density on the central-right ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural loss of tissue on the upper-left trailing edge, manifesting as two large, irregular U-shaped indentations in the pixel contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical high-intensity banding pattern located on the extreme right distal tip, distinct from the random mottling on the left lobe.
